product_metadata.title: Bare Home Pleated Twin XL Bed Skirt - 15-Inch Tailored Drop Easy Fit - Bed Skirt for Twin Extra Long Beds - Center & Corner Pleats (Twin XL, Sand)
features: PERFECT FIT: Our Twin XL Bed Skirt measures 39"x 80" with a 15" drop.

STYLISH & PRACTICAL: Take your bed to the next level. Our tailored drop twin xl bed skirt hides your bed legs and frame along with letting you use the storage space under your bed. Our twin xl size bed skirts are made with the same fabric throughout, so there is no unsightly white base like other dust ruffles.

BARE STANDARD: Our carefully crafted products are made from non-toxic premium materials in a factory that is OEKO-TEX certified. We source with these high standards to ensure you are using products free of harmful chemicals making it safe to hold against your bare skin. OEKO TEX Certification Number: 22000723.
EASY CARE: Our premium brushed microfiber is easy to care for. Wash with like colors in cool water and tumble dry on low.
REST ASSURED: Your first 30 nights are on us. Literally. If you don’t love our twin xl size bed skirt, send it back.
